descriptions.zh: 随着在§Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
descriptions.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the §Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been identified throughout the vessel.

titles.zh: 冠军之铸现场秀！比武会

descriptions.zh: 几十年过去了，一场新的锦标赛即将拉开帷幕。派你的舰队进入聚光灯下，向星系证明你的智慧、力量和决心。
descriptions.en: Decades have passed, and a new tournament is about to begin. Send your fleets into the spotlight and prove to the galaxy your wit, might, and determination.

descriptions.zh: 星系是一个美丽的地方，值得我们去保护。这里有无数的民族、希望和梦想，每一个都值得被守护。我们不寻求权力，只求和平。但和平必须得到捍卫。对于那些想要征服、毁灭或腐蚀和平的人，我们将挺身而出。只要我们屹立不倒，星系也将永存。
descriptions.en: The galaxy is a beautiful place, worth preserving. A place of countless peoples, hopes, and dreams, each one deserving of protection. We do not seek power, only peace. But peace must be defended. Against those who would conquer, destroy, or corrupt, we will stand. And as long as we stand, so too shall the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
我们若忽视这些迹象，那将是愚蠢的。这个星系中存在着邪恶势力，它们会毁掉我们努力保护的一切。我们不能坐等风暴爆发。我们必须准备好行动。

让那些威胁这个星系的人知道：我们一定会找到他们。

§H目标§!：
—消灭所有危机帝国
—击败两次终末危机
—辞去监管人职位
descriptions.en:
We would be foolish to ignore the signs. There are forces of evil in this galaxy that would unmake all we strive to protect. We cannot wait for the storm to break. We must be prepared to act.

Let those who threaten this galaxy know: we will find them.

§HOBJECTIVES§!:
- Eliminate all Crisis Empires
- Defeat two End Game Crisis
- Then End your Custodianship

descriptions.zh: 时刻已到。新的可汗即将选出。为了结束流亡，我们必须证明自己。
descriptions.en: It is time. A new Khan will be declared. To end our exile we must prove ourselves.

descriptions.zh:
§Y神圣遗址§!在祖先星图上皆有标注；它们是星系的奇观，由我们一族的先行者所发现。

探寻这些地方，并查明它们为何对我们的祖先如此重要，是我们的生来享有的权利。

随着我们开拓前进的道路，我们或许可以在拥有神圣遗址的星系中建立§Y驿站§!。
descriptions.en:
The §YSacred Sites§! are marked in the ancestral star charts; wonders of the galaxy, discovered by those who came before us.

It is our birthright to seek out these places, and find out why they were so important to our ancestors.

As we forge our path, it may be possible for us to build §YWaystations§! in systems with Sacred Sites.

descriptions.zh: §Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!在维护作业期间，底层甲板发现了一个未登记且经过重重加固的容器，该容器正发出放射性信号。由于缺乏档案记录或识别标记，其来源和用途尚不明确。
descriptions.en: During maintenance operations aboard §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, an unregistered, heavily reinforced container emitting radioactive signals was discovered on a lower deck. The lack of archival records or identifying markings leaves its origin and purpose unknown.

descriptions.zh: 来自方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的报告显示，船员中出现了轻微的行为异常，表现为社交活动增多以及士气高涨。这些变化的潜在原因尚不明确。
descriptions.en: Reports from Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! indicate minor behavioral irregularities among the crew, marked by increased socialization and elevated morale. The underlying cause of these changes remains unclear.

descriptions.zh: §Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!内部存在一个未记录在案的次级甲板层，这引发了令人不安的疑虑。其用途尚不明确，且所有关于其内部情况的现有记录均已被刻意抹除。
descriptions.en: The existence of an undocumented sub-level within §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! raises troubling questions. Its purpose remains unknown, and all available records of what lies within have been deliberately erased.

descriptions.zh: 自从进入一片异常星云以来，§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的船员们便开始遭受记忆丢失的困扰。这一现象的原因目前仍然不明。
descriptions.en: Since entering an unusual nebula, those aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have begun to suffer from memory loss. The cause of this phenomenon remains unknown.

descriptions.zh: 从一个遥远的黑洞系统中探测到了一个来源不明的结构化信号。我们必须展开调查。
descriptions.en: A structured signal of unknown origin has been detected from a distant black hole system. We must investigate.

descriptions.zh: 最近的报告显示，一种入侵性真菌物种已在§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!的整个水培舱室扩散。该真菌具有抗药性，难以遏制，正威胁着粮食生产。
descriptions.en: Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, resisting containment and threatening food production.

descriptions.zh: 前往目标帝国的恒星系并进行正式外交接触。
descriptions.en: Travel to the target empire's home system and conduct a formal diplomatic engagement.

descriptions.zh: 联合星，我们终于有了关于秋菊号下落的线索。我们必须去看看我们的姐妹舰如今以何处为家。
descriptions.en: We finally have a lead on where the Chrysanthemum ended up, Unity. We must see where our sister ship now calls home.

descriptions.zh: 该恒星系中有可采集的高价值矿物。
descriptions.en: There are valuable Minerals in this system that can be harvested.

descriptions.zh: 采集该恒星系中的可用能量。
descriptions.en: Harvest the available Energy in this system.

descriptions.zh: 收集该恒星系内可用的消费品。
descriptions.en: Collect the Consumer Goods available in this system.

descriptions.zh: 可以从该恒星系收集高价值的合金。
descriptions.en: Valuable Alloys can be harvested from this system.

descriptions.zh: 该恒星系中可以找到罕见的易爆微粒。
descriptions.en: Rare Volatile Motes can be found in this system.

descriptions.zh: 这里可以找到罕见的异星天然气。应当采集它们。
descriptions.en: Rare Exotic Gases can be found here. They should be harvested.

descriptions.zh: 该恒星系已探测到稀有水晶。采集它们。
descriptions.en: Rare Crystals have been detected in this system. Harvest them.

descriptions.zh: 根据扫描结果，该恒星系中存在活体金属。
descriptions.en: According to scans, there is Living Metal in this system.

descriptions.zh: 这里可以收获纳米机器人。
descriptions.en: There are Nanites here that can be acquired.

descriptions.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£energy£ §Y能量币§!。
descriptions.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§! cache in this system.

descriptions.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£minerals£ §Y矿物§!。
descriptions.en: Our engineers suspect that there is a £minerals£ §YMinerals§! cache in this system.

descriptions.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£alloys£ §Y合金§!。
descriptions.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £alloys£ §YAlloys§! cache in this system.

descriptions.zh: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$
descriptions.en: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$

descriptions.zh: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$
descriptions.en: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$

descriptions.zh: 我们将进入轨道，让乘客们沉浸在陌生太阳的光辉之中。
descriptions.en: We'll settle into orbit and let the passengers soak in the light of an unfamiliar sun.

descriptions.zh: 乘客中的业余天文学家发现了该星系中罕见的太阳活动，目前正在请愿要求在驻留轨道期间获得前排的观赏位置。
descriptions.en: Amateur astronomers among the passengers have spotted rare solar activity in this system and are petitioning for a front-row viewing from orbit.

descriptions.zh: 巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。
descriptions.en: The cruise is hosting a shuttle race around this system's star. Passengers are placing bets and crowding every viewport.

descriptions.zh: 疗愈中心需要长时间暴露在未经过滤的恒星辐射下，以进行乘客们一直要求的一种奇特的焕新理疗。
descriptions.en: The spa requires prolonged exposure to unfiltered stellar radiation for an exotic rejuvenation treatment the passengers have been requesting.

descriptions.zh: 一场盛大的正式舞会将在观景甲板上举行，沐浴在直射的星光下。这是此次航程中的社交盛事。
descriptions.en: A grand formal ball is to be held on the observation decks, bathed in direct starlight. The social event of the voyage.

descriptions.zh: 在主发电机进行计划维护期间，我们需要环绕该星系的恒星运行，并依靠太阳能供电。
descriptions.en: We need to orbit this system's star and run on solar power while the main generators undergo scheduled maintenance.

descriptions.zh: 外层船体板需要在持续的恒星照射下进行热荷载测试。为确保安全，朝向恒星一侧的所有舷窗都将被遮蔽。
descriptions.en: The outer hull plating requires thermal load testing under sustained stellar exposure. All viewports on the starward side will be shuttered for safety.

descriptions.zh: 冷却系统需要在热负载下进行一次完整的排空循环。近恒星轨道能让我们高效地冲洗管线，尽管甲板温度会出现波动。
descriptions.en: The coolant system needs a full purge cycle under thermal load. Close stellar orbit will let us flush the lines efficiently, though deck temperatures will fluctuate.

descriptions.zh: 导航阵列必须在近距离根据实时恒星信号进行校准。此过程将占用娱乐系统的带宽。
descriptions.en: Navigation arrays must be calibrated against a live stellar signature at close range. The process will commandeer bandwidth from entertainment systems.

descriptions.zh: 水循环系统需要进行一次高强度的紫外线杀菌，此过程只有在近恒星轨道上才能高效完成。疗愈中心与游泳池现已关闭，各层甲板均实行限量供水。
descriptions.en: The water recyclers need an intensive UV sterilization run that is only efficient in close stellar orbit. The spa and pool are closed and water is rationed across all decks.

descriptions.zh: 乘客们渴望踏上坚实的土地，去探索下方的外星城市。我们已经安排了由向导带领的进城游览。
descriptions.en: The passengers are eager to set foot on solid ground and explore the alien city below. We've arranged guided excursions into the city.

descriptions.zh: 下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。
descriptions.en: The renowned dining districts on the planet below have agreed to host the passengers for a guided tasting tour of local cuisine.

descriptions.zh: 该星球的首都设有一座享誉星系的博物馆。乘客们一直在请愿，要求安排带有导游的游览活动，以参观其中的纪念碑和历史展品。
descriptions.en: The planet's capital hosts a museum of galactic renown. Passengers have been petitioning for a guided tour of its monuments and historical exhibits.

descriptions.zh: 地表上一个庞大的露天市场交易着来自整个星域的商品。乘客们迫不及待地想要去逛一逛并讨价还价。
descriptions.en: A sprawling open-air market on the surface deals in goods from across the sector. The passengers are eager to browse and haggle.

descriptions.zh: 下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。
descriptions.en: A nature reserve on the planet below offers guided tours through its alien wilderness. Passengers will observe alien fauna from guided walkways.

descriptions.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc1]
descriptions.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc1]

descriptions.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]
descriptions.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]

descriptions.zh: 储备即将耗尽。船组小队将前往星球表面寻找备件、原材料，以及飞船制造机在几个周期前就已停止生产的各类补给品。
descriptions.en: Stores are running low. Crew teams will go planetside to source replacement parts, raw materials, and the supplies the ship's fabricators stopped producing cycles ago.

descriptions.zh: 当地工程师已开放他们的设施供考察。他们对常见工程问题的解决方案与我们的模型存在显著差异，而当地人也同样渴望研究方舟舰。
descriptions.en: Local engineers have opened their facilities for inspection. Their solutions to common engineering problems diverge significantly from our own models, and the locals are equally eager to study the Arkship.

descriptions.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]
descriptions.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]

descriptions.zh: 为了娱乐乘客，我们将在指定的恒星系中部署一颗非功能性的“间谍卫星”。
descriptions.en: To entertain the passengers, we'll deploy a non-functional "spy satellite" in the indicated system.

descriptions.zh: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]
descriptions.en: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]

descriptions.zh: 乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。
descriptions.en: Passengers are taken on guided excursions to the city below, where crew operatives have planted fake intelligence packages at prearranged locations for them to discover.

descriptions.zh: 全船各层甲板已通报发生一起模拟的安全事件。乘客们被招募参与一场全船范围的调查游戏，以找出安插在船员中的“外来特工”。
descriptions.en: A staged security breach has been announced across all decks. Passengers are recruited to identify planted 'foreign agents' among the crew in a ship-wide investigation game.

descriptions.zh: 观景台已被改造为监听站。乘客们驻守在这些站点，破译着船员们从底层甲板秘密发送的、预先编排好的外星信号。
descriptions.en: The observation decks have been converted into listening posts. Passengers man the stations, decoding scripted alien transmissions that the crew is secretly broadcasting from below decks.

descriptions.zh: 船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。
descriptions.en: Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.

descriptions.zh: 停靠权和边境通行权可能会在毫无预警的情况下被撤销。一颗监控政府通信的监视卫星将告诉我们，这个帝国的热情好客究竟是真诚的还是有条件的。
descriptions.en: Docking privileges and border access can be revoked without warning. A surveillance satellite monitoring government communications will tell us whether this empire's hospitality is genuine or conditional.

descriptions.zh: 我们预定航线上的舰队动向、边界变动与军事集结可能会使飞船受困于敌对星区。侦察卫星将为导航提供足够的预警时间，以便规划备用路线。
descriptions.en: Fleet movements, border shifts, and military buildups along our projected route could strand the ship in hostile space. A surveillance satellite will give navigation enough lead time to plot alternatives.

descriptions.zh: 当采购部门了解真实价格时，供应谈判会进展得更加顺利。一颗监控贸易渠道和资源流向的监视卫星，将确保我们的团队在下一个港口不会支付过高的价格。
descriptions.en: Supply negotiations go better when procurement knows the real prices. A surveillance satellite monitoring trade channels and resource flows will ensure our teams are not overpaying at the next port.

descriptions.zh: 该地区出现了反游牧情绪的相关报道。侦察卫星将确认这一局势仅仅是空谈，还是正在成为当地的政策。
descriptions.en: Reports of anti-nomad sentiment have surfaced in this region. A surveillance satellite will confirm whether the talk is just rhetoric or whether it is becoming policy.

descriptions.zh: $contract_espionage_support_nomad_desc$
descriptions.en: $contract_espionage_support_nomad_desc$

descriptions.zh: 加入§Y[From.GetName]§!的所有战争。
descriptions.en: Join the §Y[From.GetName]§! in all their wars.

descriptions.zh: 对该系统进行深度扫描，以评估其资源和战略相关性。
descriptions.en: Complete a Deep Scan of this system to assess its resources and strategic relevance.

descriptions.zh: 代表§Y[from.GetName]§!轰炸行星以积累§Y荒废度§!。
descriptions.en: Bombard planets on behalf of §Y[from.GetName]§! to build up §YDevastation§!.

descriptions.zh: 支援巨型结构的建造。
descriptions.en: Assist with the construction of a Megastructure.

descriptions.zh: 扫描一场战斗之后留下的残骸。
descriptions.en: Scan the debris left behind after a battle.

descriptions.zh: 清理该帝国的殖民地上所有的行星自然障碍。
descriptions.en: Clear every Natural Planetary Blockers from this Empire's Colony.

descriptions.zh: 在此帝国的某个恒星系中建造一座驿站。
descriptions.en: Build a Waystation in this Empire's system.

descriptions.zh: 该恒星系的太空兽群正给我们带来麻烦。请铲除它们。
descriptions.en: The Space Fauna in this system are causing us problems. Please eradicate them.

descriptions.zh: 模糊的记忆指引着§Y塞拉伦涅§!飘向星海深处。前往那里应当能帮她想起更多往事。
descriptions.en: Faint memories pull §YSeralune§! toward distant points in the stars. Traveling there should help her to remember more.

descriptions.zh: 将代表团运输至§Y[from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的§Y[from.capital_scope.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: Transport delegates to §Y[from.capital_scope.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§! system.

descriptions.zh:
从§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!接收罪犯。我们将按认为合适的方式驱逐他们，并可以选择将他们留在船上或送往另一个殖民地。我们不应将他们带回属于§Y[from.GetName]§!的行星。

在接收囚犯后，选择将他们§Y留在船上§!，或使用方舟舰指令“§Y移交囚犯§!”将他们§Y捎到§!我们选择的殖民地。
descriptions.en:
Pick up criminals from §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!. We are to deport them as we see fit, and can choose to either keep them aboard or drop them off on another colony. We are not supposed to bring them back to a planet owned by §Y[from.GetName]§!.

After collecting the prisoners, choose to either §YKeep Them§! aboard or to §YDrop Them Off§! at a colony of our choice using the §YDrop Off Prisoners§! Arkship action.

descriptions.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£physics£ §Y物理学研究§!。
descriptions.en: Conduct £physics£ §YPhysics Research§! aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

descriptions.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£society£ §Y社会学研究§!。
descriptions.en: Conduct £society£ §YSociety Research§! aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

descriptions.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ §Y工程学研究§!。
descriptions.en: Conduct £engineering£ §YEngineering Research§! aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

descriptions.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ §Y工程学研究§!，以改善该恒星系现有的£minerals£ §Y矿物§!矿脉分布。
descriptions.en: Conduct £engineering£ §YEngineering Research§! aboard an Arkship to improve existing £minerals£ §YMinerals§! deposits in this system.

descriptions.zh: 开展£physics£ §Y物理学研究§!研究以改进该恒星系中现有的£energy£ §Y能量币§!来源。
descriptions.en: Conduct £physics£ §YPhysics Research§! to improve existing sources of £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§! in this system.

descriptions.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£society£ §Y社会学研究§!，以提高该星系中可开发的£food£ §Y食物§!储量。
descriptions.en: Conduct £society£ §YSociety Research§! aboard an Arkship to improve exploitable deposits of £food£ §YFood§! in this system.

descriptions.zh: 带领一群游客进行一场银河观光之旅。
descriptions.en: Take a group of tourists on a galactic sightseeing tour.

descriptions.zh: 协助让这个新殖民地设立且高效地运转起来。
descriptions.en: Help get this new colony up and running efficiently.

descriptions.zh: 我们获得可靠情报，§Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§!的掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系。这将是一个埋伏他们的绝佳机会。
descriptions.en: We have good intelligence that the §Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§! raiding fleet will be passing through this system. It will be a great opportunity for an ambush.

descriptions.zh: 看来§Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§!已在此恒星系建立了一处哨站。我们应该在他们站稳脚跟前将其铲除。
descriptions.en: It seems that the §Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§! have set up an outpost in this system. We should knock it out before they get a foothold.

titles.zh: 提名冠铸秀锦标赛的举办恒星系

descriptions.zh: 我们已经购买了下一届“冠军之铸现场秀！”锦标赛的场地权。或许我们可以利用这一点为我们谋取优势。
descriptions.en: We have purchased the venue rights for the next Champion's Forge Live! tournament. Perhaps we can use this for our advantage.

descriptions.zh: 使用方舟舰的恒星引擎将气态巨行星转化为新生恒星，为该恒星系解锁海量资源。
descriptions.en: Use the Arkship's Stellar Engine to transform a gas giant into a newborn star, unlocking vast resources for the system.

descriptions.zh: 在我们伟大的征程中，我们追踪所发现的每一颗恒星、每一个星系以及每一个新生命。
descriptions.en: In the course of our great journey, we track every star, system and new being we find.

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.zh: 方舟舰上的资源正在莫名其妙地消失。某种东西的消耗量超过了记录在案的数值。此事应当展开调查。
descriptions.en: Resources aboard the Arkship are disappearing without explanation. Something is consuming more than the records account for. This should be investigated.

descriptions.zh: 一个密封的信息和一组从漂流的休眠舱中回收的坐标。无论它们背后隐藏着什么故事，它都等待了很长时间才被世人发现。
descriptions.en: A sealed message and a set of coordinates recovered from a drifting stasis pod. Whatever story lies behind them, it has waited a long time to be told.
